title: A bull in a car – level 2
paragraphs: In Norfolk, the United States, the police responded to reports of a man driving with a cow in his car.

When they stopped the car, they were surprised to find a massive Watusi bull as the passenger. The police issued the driver a warning due to the unusual situation, which could possibly cause an accident. The bull’s name was Howdy Doody, and the driver had to make some changes in his car to fit the bull in. This incident attracted attention from onlookers who called the police. It’s unclear where the bull and the driver were going.
